instruction: Read the screenshot and report each field below exactly as displayed. Use null for anything you cannot read.

expectations.description: Name of the application shown in the window
GPU model name in the top panel
Application version in the top panel title
GPU architecture code on the second line of the top panel
Device VRAM used and total in the Memory Usage panel
Device GTT used and total in the Memory Usage panel
Name of the first process in the fdinfo table
VRAM of that first process in the fdinfo table
Titles of the panels below the top panel, as a list
